correctness.rationale: The indicator-column differences in each minor are disjoint ordered intervals, giving the stated zero-or-positive-monomial formula. This justifies entrywise order of the compounds and hence their norms; strict operator norm follows by testing the strictly larger Gram matrix on a nonnegative top vector. The Poisson average gives Ky Fan order by convexity and the strict Schatten norm order by strict convexity and the nonconstant conjugation orbit. For the counting lemma, discard the first aN rows at rank cost O(aN), the last rows beyond bN at norm cost O(1/(bN)), and block interfaces at rank cost bounded independently of N for a fixed partition and bandwidth. After freezing ND on the blocks, the empirical Toeplitz singular law can also be seen by comparison with circulant sections at rank cost at most the bandwidth. Sample block positions outside threshold atoms, use upper and lower threshold margins, and refine the partition to integrate the monotone symbol count in x; the integral over x>0 is the angular mean divided by the threshold parameter. The l¹ coefficient tail has s_n at most its mass divided by n, so the two-sided count inequalities transfer the limit. Monotone inversion, elliptic substitution, and harmonic/zeta comparison give the singular and trace limits. All assertions are for fixed t<1; they include the diagonal t=0 case. Compact triangularity gives the stated spectrum: for each diagonal value, its eigenvector may alternatively be obtained by the recurrence (i−j)x_i=t i x_{i−1} starting at index j.
residual_risks: Weak empirical convergence alone cannot evaluate a threshold at an atom; choosing sample points away from those atoms and using threshold margins closes this detail. No uniform endpoint result at t=1 is verified or claimed.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The banded theorem applies to D∑_{j≤M}t^j S^j. The infinitely many original diagonals are not covered by the banded theorem without this transfer.

evidence: For |z|<1, F_k(z)=∧^k[D(I−zS)^−1] is operator-norm analytic. Changing arg z is unitary conjugation by ∧^k diag(e^{ij arg z}); thus on each circle the norm of F_k is constant. The scalar maximum principle applied to ⟨y,F_k(z)x⟩ for unit x,y proves the norm monotonicity in radius. This extends beyond the minor-positive case.

The inspected Rhaly and Albanese–Bonet–Ricker passages establish or describe compactness and ordinary spectrum, not rankwise exterior order. Prior Weyl coverage and its applicability are separate from those ordinary spectral facts.

The explicit minor formula offers an alternative proof, not a materially stronger norm result.

originality.rationale: A material advertised result, the sharp singular endpoint with the elliptic coefficient, is covered. A distinct indexed finding proves a stronger asymptotic for a unitarily equivalent realization, and another proves a block generalization specializing to the same coefficient. Their same UTC date does not establish priority. Independently, Pushnitski's earlier banded-matrix theorem gives the endpoint by truncation and a weak-Schatten tail estimate. The distinct indexed findings inspected do not establish exterior-power order, but that order also follows directly from the classical maximum principle for the analytic exterior powers of C_z with radial norms; no new ordering principle is needed.
residual_risks: No chronological conclusion from the same-day indexed entries. Earlier verbatim statements of the exterior order remain unresolved. The Zizler et al. primary text was not retrieved; the originality failure rests on the verified overlaps and prior theorem, not that access limitation.

value.rationale: The sharp coefficient is natural, but the frozen record rederives a covered endpoint without improving its known precision. The remaining rankwise inequalities are a direct maximum-principle deduction for this rotation-equivariant analytic family; the minor formula is a short calculation on a staircase matrix and no application requiring it, or nontrivial ordering enhancement, is established in the finding. A self-contained alternative derivation has expository utility but does not supply a distinct valuable scientific finding here.
residual_risks: No claim that the operator itself lacks scientific interest; the value assessment is for the incremental content of this submission.
